A free online notepad with the features that matter

Web Notepad is a rich text editor that lives in your browser. There is nothing to install, no account to create and no ads to dismiss. Open the page, type, and come back later: your notes will be there.

Rich text formatting
Bold, italic, underline and strikethrough, plus fonts, sizes, text color and highlight color.
Lists, links and images
Bulleted and numbered lists, clickable links, and images you insert or paste.
Auto-Save
Every change is saved in your browser about once a second, and Force Save (Ctrl+S) saves instantly.
Export to six formats
Download your note as PDF, Word, HTML, TXT, Markdown or JSON.
Share with QR code
Send a note to your phone or a friend with a 6-digit code or QR code. Shared copies are deleted after 1 hour.
Speech tools
Dictate with speech to text, or have your note read aloud with text to speech.
Live statistics
Characters, words, lines and estimated reading time update as you type.
Dark mode
Switch themes with one click. Your choice is remembered.
Keyboard shortcuts
Standard shortcuts for formatting, undo, redo, links and saving.
Works offline
After the first visit the notepad loads and saves without a connection.

How the online notepad works

Changes are saved as you work using the HTML5 localStorage API. The editor copies your note, with its formatting, into your browser’s storage about one second after you stop typing, so your data stays on your device. Your notes remain in the browser until you clear cookies and other site data. When you share a note, only that note’s text is sent to the server, and only for an hour.

A notepad for every device

Use it as a notepad for PC on Windows, macOS and Linux, and as a notepad app for Android and iPhone that runs in your browser. It works in current versions of Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Safari and Opera. JavaScript must be enabled.

Bookmark the page with Ctrl+D (Command+D on Mac). On mobile, choose “Add to Home Screen” for an app-like experience.

Tips for using Web Notepad

  • Use the Export buttons regularly to back up important notes to your computer.
  • Press Ctrl+S (Command+S) to force a save at any time.
  • Watch the word and reading-time counters to track a writing target.
  • Your notes persist between sessions unless you clear your browser’s site data.

Privacy and security

Your notes are stored locally in your browser, so they stay private to you. We do not receive what you type. The one exception is Share: the note you choose to share (text and formatting) is held in server memory for 1 hour so someone with the code can open it, then it is deleted. We do not use advertising trackers.

Frequently asked questions

Is this notepad free?

Yes. Web Notepad is a free online notepad with no login, no signup and no ads.

Are my notes private?

Your notes are stored in your own browser and are not sent to a server while you type. Only if you choose Share is the note stored on the server, and it is deleted after 1 hour.

Can I format my text?

Yes. Web Notepad is a rich text editor: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, fonts and sizes, text and highlight colors, alignment, bulleted and numbered lists, links and images.

Which formats can I export to?

You can export your note as PDF (through the print dialog, choose Save as PDF), Word (.doc), HTML, plain text (TXT), Markdown (MD) or JSON.

How do I share a note?

Click Share to get a 6-digit code and a QR code. On another device, scan the QR code or open Receiver and enter the digits. The shared copy, with its formatting, expires after 1 hour.

How do I install it as a notepad app?

On Android, open the Chrome menu and choose Add to Home screen. On iPhone, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen. On desktop Chrome or Edge, use the install icon in the address bar.

Does this notepad work offline?

Yes. After your first visit the app is cached by your browser, and notes autosave locally, so you can keep writing without a connection. Sharing and receiving need a connection.

Will I lose my notes if I clear my browser data?

Yes. Notes live in your browser until you clear cookies and other site data. Use the Export buttons to back up important notes to your computer.
